label: hedge move ARRIVAL ESTIMATE from the PROBE at a FIXED 45 ms delay from the fill, 7 TRAIN days (owner decision 6 Nov 2026, v1_2 only); EXPLORATORY
method: PROBE: one 1 SOL Bybit bid per 15 s slot at the strategy's quote depth (qv2_probe.py, v1.1 fill rules, 00:00-02:00 UTC slice of each day); bid = the Binance mid move (bps) from each simulated probe fill to fill + 45 ms, mean over all fills. The 45 ms is an ASSUMED hedge arrival delay (the singapore preset gives about 31-52 ms for a hedge), NOT measured on mainnet. The probe is bid-only: the ask value is the market-data value, carried over unchanged and unused while maker_passive_side is bid
window: fixed delay from the fill, ASSUMED arrival estimate

bid.note: se_bps treats fills as independent and understates; read se_day_block_bps (7 day blocks)

provenance.probe_code: out/queue_v2/qv2_probe.py (unchanged), live tree after Phase B0
provenance.delay_analysis: offline from the probe fills and the Binance L1 series (session script b0f_probe7.py)
